Good Food with Some Misses
Jul 2026 • Solo
The fried squid was a bit overcooked, and the batter didn’t stick to the squid very well. However, I really liked the sauce that came with it. The beef rolls were flavorful, and the beef was tender and soft. I usually don’t like betel leaves, but I liked how thin the leaves were here, as they didn’t overpower the beef. The salad was fresh and made with high-quality ingredients. For the salmon dish, I didn’t like how much the fish sauce stood out in the caramelized sauce since it made the flavor a bit too strong for me. The soup was rich, and the prawn and the vegetables in it were soft. I liked that the bean curd dessert wasn’t overly sweet. 
The staff members were welcoming and attentive.

 The service was exceptional.

Disappointed.
Jun 2026 • Family
Unfortunately this restaurant did not deliver on food or service. We had been there 15 mins and had to ask to order drinks, food came out at odd times such as main before appetiser and one of our groups meal came when the rest of us were halfway through ours. No staff asked how our meals were or were very helpful or attentive. No offer to take a second drink order. Whilst not expensive compared to Australian prices, in Vietnam its on the more expensive side and definitely better restaurants based on food snd service to choose from. We went elsewhere for desert and another drink.

Fancy but tasteless
Mar 2026 • Couples
It was with high expectations I returned to Vietnam House. Having had so many good meals here back in the days. But now everything has changed.

The place is still very fancy with even a mor sophisticated decor. Extremely nice interior decorations. And on the top floor they lift it to even higher levels. Both fancy and romantic.

So it was with great expectations we ordered the set menu with wine pairing.

Wine was fine, and food very nicely presented. Good job.

BUT

Where was the taste? Completely gone. I don't mind if the food is is sparsely spiced, if it is done with good intentions and well balanced. But here we could not detect any flavors at all. Nothing!

So it is with a heavy heart that I only can rate this present Vietnam House a 3 star.
